summary.en: Post-punk and garage guitar bands reclaim radio after nu-metal and laptop pop.
summary.zh: 后朋克与车库吉他乐队在 Nu-Metal 与笔记本流行乐之后重占电台。

sound.en: Tight garage snap, post-punk freeze, three-minute singles, lean production
sound.zh: 紧 Garage 脆响、后朋克冷感、三分钟单曲、精简制作

body.en:
After nu-metal and early digital pop dominate US/UK charts, New York bands like The Strokes put three-minute guitar songs back on MTV and indie press around 2001. The White Stripes and others keep garage minimalism visible. Arctic Monkeys (2005–06) show MySpace and UK indie press can break a guitar band fast.

Rock stays on the axis with shorter songs, smaller clubs first, then festival scale again.
body.zh:
在 Nu-Metal 与早期数字流行占据美英榜单之后，约 2001 年 The Strokes 等纽约乐队把三分钟吉他歌送回 MTV 与独立媒体。The White Stripes 等让车库极简仍可见。Arctic Monkeys（2005–06）证明 MySpace 与英国独立媒体能快速打出吉他乐队。

摇滚仍在主轴上：歌更短，先从小俱乐部再回到音乐节尺度。
